# ⚡ Energy Starcraft --- ## 🌟 About **Energy Starcraft** is a Minecraft NeoForge mod that revolutionizes how you obtain Nether Stars by replacing dangerous Nether expeditions with a fully automated, energy-powered crafting system. Feed your forge with FE energy from any popular tech mod and watch as it produces Nether Stars on demand — perfect for late-game automation and mass production. --- ## 📦 Installation 1. Install **[NeoForge 21.1.233+](https://neoforged.net/)** for Minecraft 1.21.1 2. Download the latest `netherstarforge-X.X.X.jar` from releases 3. Drop the JAR into your `.minecraft/mods/` folder 4. Launch the game and enjoy ⭐ --- ## 📜 License Released under the **MIT License**. Feel free to use, modify, and distribute. --- ## 💬 Support & Feedback Found a bug? Have a suggestion? Open an issue on Discord or contact the developer. ---
